## Target journals

The main dissemination channel is publication in leading journals (JCR Q1/Q2 or ABS 3/4/4\*). Methodological results (WP1–WP3) target journals such as *Journal of Econometrics*, *Sociological Methods & Research*, *Social Indicators Research*, *Journal of Economic Inequality* and *Computational Statistics & Data Analysis*. The R package (WP4) targets the *Journal of Statistical Software*, and the applications (WP5) target journals in Water Resources, Tourism, Management and Business.

## Software

- **theil**: Theil indices, bias corrections, variances and confidence intervals. R package with a C++ core. <span class="pending">Forthcoming on CRAN.</span>
- **giniVarCI**: Gini indices, variances and confidence intervals for finite and infinite populations, developed in the previous project [GiniUs](https://jfmunozrosas.github.io/ginius/). <https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=giniVarCI>
- **samplingVarEst**: Sampling variance estimation. <https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=samplingVarEst>

## Previous publications of the team (2023–2026) {#previous-publications}

Many of these articles result from the previous project [GiniUs](https://jfmunozrosas.github.io/ginius/){target="_blank"} (PID2022-136235NB-I00).
